# 0. Loading pre-processed data

Pre-processed data is read from 'pre_processed_data_TIF_moreyra.csv' which was created with the code in 'data_pre_processing.Rmd'.

```{r}

pre_processed_data <- read.csv("pre_processed_data_TIF_moreyra.csv") %>% 
  filter(validation == TRUE) ## Select only data with TRUE in validation column

```


# 1. Filter variables for reject criteria

## 1.1. Age

Explore age distribution

```{r}

pre_processed_data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Edad))+
  geom_histogram(color = "white", binwidth = 1)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 18, )+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 29)


```
Filter by criteria

```{r}

lower_age = 19
higher_age = 29

pre_processed_data %>% 
  summarise(lower_age = sum(Edad < lower_age),
            higher_age = sum(Edad > higher_age))


age_filtered_data <- pre_processed_data %>% 
  filter(Edad >= lower_age,
         Edad <= higher_age)

```
## Psychiatric or neurologic dx

```{r}

dx_list <- c("depresion",
             # "depresión",
             "tdah", "tda", "tdh",
             "ansiedad",
             "trastorno",
             "tea", "autismo",
             "asperger", "sindrome",
             "retraso",   # Troll
             "consumo")

dx_list <-  paste(dx_list, collapse = "|")

age_filtered_dx_data <- age_filtered_data %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(dx_info, regex(dx_list, ignore_case = TRUE)) | is.na(dx_info))

age_filtered_data %>% 
  summarise(with_dx = sum(!str_detect(dx_info, regex(dx_list, ignore_case = TRUE)), na.rm = T))



```

## Residence

```{r}

table(age_filtered_dx_data$Provincia)

age_filtered_dx_place_data <- age_filtered_dx_data %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Provincia))

```
```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# 1. Seleccionar solo los ítems del cuestionario y quitar NAs
datos_para_outliers <- datos_pre_cfa %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("ID") %>% 
  select(starts_with("CHS")) %>%
  select(-contains("score"))

# 2. Calcular la Distancia de Mahalanobis
distancia_mahalanobis <- mahalanobis(
  x = datos_para_outliers, 
  center = colMeans(datos_para_outliers), 
  cov = cov(datos_para_outliers)
)

# 3. Calcular la probabilidad (p-valor) de que ese patrón exista
# Se usa una distribución Chi-cuadrado con grados de libertad = cantidad de ítems
grados_libertad <- ncol(datos_para_outliers)
p_valores <- pchisq(distancia_mahalanobis, df = grados_libertad, lower.tail = FALSE)

# 4. Agregar los p-valores a tu dataset y filtrar los casos extremos (p < 0.001)
casos_sospechosos <- datos_para_outliers %>%
  mutate(
    distancia = distancia_mahalanobis,
    p_valor = p_valores
  ) %>%
  filter(p_valor < 0.001) %>%
  arrange(p_valor)

# Ver la tabla con los sujetos más raros de tu muestra
# print(casos_sospechosos)



library(dplyr)

# Convertir a puntajes Z para ver a cuántos desvíos estándar está cada sujeto
outliers_univariados <- datos_para_outliers %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ scale(.) %>% as.numeric() %>% abs())) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("ID") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -ID) %>% 
  filter(value > 3) 


outlier_subjects <- unique(outliers_univariados$ID)
  

```




# Checking questionnaire with CFA

```{r}

datos_pre_cfa <- age_filtered_dx_place_data %>% 
                filter(validation == TRUE) %>% 
                filter(!is.na(Provincia)) %>% 
                filter(videogame_hours != "No juego") %>% 
                filter(videogame_hours_week < 90) %>% 
  filter(!ID%in% outlier_subjects) %>% 
  filter(Sexo != "Otro")

#+ CHS_U_academic_4
#+  CHS_U_conversation_20

modelo_cfa <- '
  CHS_U_academic_component =~ CHS_U_academic_1 + CHS_U_academic_2 + CHS_U_academic_3 
  CHS_U_opposition_component =~ CHS_U_opposition_5 + CHS_U_opposition_6 + CHS_U_opposition_7 + CHS_U_opposition_8
  CHS_U_empathetic_component =~ CHS_U_empathetic_9 + CHS_U_empathetic_10 + CHS_U_empathetic_11 + CHS_U_empathetic_12
  CHS_U_affective_component =~ CHS_U_affective_13 + CHS_U_affective_14 + CHS_U_affective_15 + CHS_U_affective_16
  CHS_U_conversation_component =~ CHS_U_conversation_17 + CHS_U_conversation_18 + CHS_U_conversation_19 
  
  
  CHS_U_general_component =~ CHS_U_academic_component+CHS_U_opposition_component+CHS_U_empathetic_component+CHS_U_affective_component+CHS_U_conversation_component
'

ajuste <- cfa(modelo_cfa, data = datos_pre_cfa
              )


summary(ajuste, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)

datos_finales <- cbind(datos_pre_cfa, lavPredict(ajuste))

# indices_mod <- modindices(ajuste, sort = TRUE, maximum.number = 10)

# indices_mod

```
